name: SWM
sub: Robotaxi & passenger L4; Robotaxi consumer services
about: Korean autonomy developer running the country's first driverless taxi service, in Seoul's Gangnam district, on KG Mobility vehicles and an NVIDIA DRIVE platform.
deployment: Driverless taxi service in Seoul's Gangnam district since September 2024, Korea's first; the operating area is expanding from parts of Gangnam-gu and Seocho-gu to the full 20.4 sq km Gangnam pilot zone. Rides are free of fares and run with a safety operator aboard.
metrics: 7,754 cumulative rides reported accident-free; a fleet target of up to 3,000 vehicles by the end of 2026.
signal: Lenovo partnership to build a next-generation robotaxi on NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor; KG Mobility Torres EVX platform deal (2026)

sources.title: Lenovo works with SWM to develop next-generation robotaxi on NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor
KGM Torres EVX strengthens cooperation with SWM in self-driving sector, expanding services to Gangnam, Seoul
